packageRules.description: Automerge patch/minor once CI is green; majors wait for review

Never automerge the graphify package. The `/graphify` skill it ships is vendored into home/dot_claude/skills rather than left to `graphify install`, which writes straight into $HOME over chezmoi — so a version bump is only half the change, and the other half is re-vendoring the skill by hand into a scratch HOME. Automerging moved the tool while the skill describing it stayed behind, silently, which is what had already happened (pin 0.9.32, vendored skill 0.9.30). `mise run lint` now asserts the two agree, so an automerged bump would fail CI rather than drift — but a red main is not the right way to find out.

Never automerge .chezmoiexternals. Two reasons, both load-bearing. (1) These fetch code that runs as you — mise installs and executes every other tool, devpod drives containers holding your forwarded ssh-agent, and the plugin externals are sourced into every shell — while CI only asserts the fetched file is non-empty, never that its contents are what was expected. Automerge would take a compromised upstream release from a tag to every machine's next apply with nobody reading it. (2) mise and devpod now carry checksum.sha256 lines that Renovate cannot update, so a bumped version with a stale hash fails the apply; that is the right failure mode, but it must not land on main unattended. Bump version and checksum together, by hand.
